mapper.sql: id, code, name, description, data_source_id, audience, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, top_k, weight, embedding_model, enabled, doc_count, chunk_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (code, name, description, data_source_id, audience, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, top_k, weight, embedding_model, enabled, doc_count, chunk_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{dataSourceId}, COALESCE(#{audience}, 'all'), COALESCE(#{chunkSize}, 200), COALESCE(#{chunkOverlap}, 50), COALESCE(#{topK}, 5), COALESCE(#{weight}, 1.000), #{embeddingModel}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM knowledge_base
AND code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND (audience = #{audience} OR audience = 'all')
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY id ASC
LIMIT #{current},#{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base
AND code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND (audience = #{audience} OR audience = 'all')
AND enabled = #{enabled}

SELECT FROM knowledge_base WHERE enabled = 1
AND (audience = #{audience} OR audience = 'all')
ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id FROM knowledge_base WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
